artifact_name: CallRank public camera-ready code and aggregate results
research_boundary: Fixed-head temporal evaluation on a clean-room call ledger. Ranking coefficients use only outcomes completed by December 1, 2020 and are not refit during the reported evaluation.
snapshot_status: Versioned artifact for reproducing the reported fixed-head ranking, allocation, and identity-controlled mechanism tests.

feature_definition.reference: expanding mean of the same firm's prior Q&A vectors
feature_definition.raw_residual: current Q&A minus prior-firm Q&A mean
feature_definition.sector_aggregation: equal mean across eligible firms before model fitting
feature_definition.multi_resolution_ensemble: average within-month prediction ranks from 128-, 160-, and 200-word models

section_parser_scope: Q&A-side text may include analyst turns; the paper studies a Q&A-side contrast rather than an answer-only measure.

text_construction.operation_order: minimum-word filter, character cap, whitespace normalization, non-overlapping word passages

universe.sector_taxonomy: GICS sectors mapped to SPDR sector ETFs
universe.paper_mapping: dated membership and sector records attached at the verified call date, with the major 2016, 2018, and 2023 taxonomy changes reconstructed without return data

data_integrity.training_audit_sampling: deterministic return-blind hash order, up to two calls per sector-year, prioritizing distinct issuers

target.definition: 42-trading-day sector ETF return in excess of SPY
target.entry_timing: first trading day after month-end aggregation
target.first_common_date_rule: strategy and SPY returns both start at zero; strategy entry costs are charged on the first common date

ranking_head.target: within-month percentile rank of 42-day excess return, centered at zero
ranking_head.fit_scope: separate scaler, PCA rotation, and Ridge coefficients for every representation and passage length
ranking_head.provenance: Reported PCA-32/Ridge-1e4 specification; fitted only on outcomes completed by December 1, 2020 and not refit during the reported evaluation.

portfolio.rule: One argmax Top 1 monthly sleeve, with Bottom 1 and Top 1-minus-Bottom 1 reported as diagnostics
portfolio.selection: highest or lowest predicted sector score
portfolio.weighting: selected sectors' point-in-time constituent market capitalization at the prior trading close
portfolio.reported_tie_policy: canonical sector-key order fixed without returns
portfolio.tie_sensitivity: include every exact cutoff tie and weight tied sectors by prior-close capitalization
portfolio.spread_cost_scope: the 200% gross diagnostic spread deducts ETF turnover costs but not borrow fees or financing charges
portfolio.sharpe_risk_free: latest strictly prior DGS3MO yield, converted to a compounded daily return
